post.line: The sorting pile is still on the counter. Come sort it before it learns the alphabet.

condo.line: The arcade floor and machines are waiting. Come in when you can; neither has improved itself.

store.line: The store shelf needs restocking. Come in when you can; the empty spaces have become very confident.

post.line: I have taken you off the book. The post office door stays open if you want work again.

condo.line: I have taken your name off the arcade book. If you want work again, come ask me; the door is still open.

store.line: I have taken your name off the store book. If you want work again, come ask me; the bell is still there.

wage.line: I have filed {n} coins for the work you finished. They waited in the folder, as folders do.

welcome.line: I have entered {home} in the big book. The plot is yours at last. I am glad to close that folder.

movedin.line: I swept past {home} and saw the tent up. It looks lived in now, which is the point of a tent.

firstbeast.line: I heard there is an animal at {home}. Good. A plot with an animal has started making sense.

shed.line: I hear your shed is filling up. Good. A thing on a shelf is a thing with plans.

week.line: The big book says {home} has been yours for one week. I thought you should know; it rarely volunteers.
